description: Bivio — Colore: Blue-grey & silver Collezione: Crossroads Codice: 5852 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 139.5 cm Rapporto: 3 cm × 1.5 cm Toni: Blue BIVIO (Italian for crossroads) translates the idea of life's choices into a small-scale geometric textile. Its interlocking linework creates a complex maze to trace across the surface, with simple shapes suggesting a basket-weave structure that is both precise and quietly hypnotic. In the CROSSROADS collection , BIVIO is rendered in 100% cotton, a version that emphasizes the clarity and graphic quality of the design over the textural depth of its LUCIS velvet counterpart. The cotton ground gives the pattern a sharper visual edge, making it particularly effective for upholstery applications where the geometric structure needs to hold across both flat and curved surfaces. Available in blue-grey, Byzantium, and platinum monotone colorways.
